summary.text: James Moylan was elected in 2022 as Guam's Delegate to the U.S. House of Representatives and was re-elected for the 119th Congress.

paragraphs.text: Before that he was elected to the 35th Guam Legislature in 2019 and re-elected to the 36th, and earlier worked as a probation officer at Guam's Department of Corrections for seven years and in the insurance industry.
He was born and raised in Guam, graduated from the University of Guam with a degree in Criminal Justice, enlisted in the U.S. Army and later served in the Guam National Guard.
